en: The image shows an old, domed building with arched windows, likely a church, situated on a slightly elevated, rough terrain. The architecture appears Byzantine or Ottoman-influenced, with a rounded dome and simple, sturdy construction. There are a few smaller buildings and trees around it. The postcard is in black and white, giving it a vintage feel. Printed text in French and English at the bottom identifies the location and subject as an old Greek church in Salonica (modern Thessaloniki).
